lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，阴影中挪动着庞大的身躯。
lines.en: Sssss, moving its massive form in the shadows.

lines.zh: 它的皮肤闪耀着深邃的黑暗光芒。
lines.en: Its skin glows with deep, dark light.

lines.zh: 两面脸庞同步眨眼，诡异的视线。
lines.en: Both faces blink in unison, creepy gaze.

lines.zh: 不断变换着声音，模仿着召唤者。
lines.en: Its voice mimics the summoner's, constantly changing.

lines.zh: 沉重的脚步声回荡在末地。
lines.en: Heavy footsteps echo in the End.

lines.zh: 黑暗的双眼闪烁着狡猾的光芒。
lines.en: Dark eyes gleam with cunning.

lines.zh: 发出低沉的嘶嘶声，似乎在思考。
lines.en: Sssss, as if in thought.

lines.zh: 缓慢地向前移动，每一步都充满威胁。
lines.en: Slowly advances, each step threatening.

lines.zh: 模仿着玩家的动作，令人不安。
lines.en: Mimics the player's movements, unsettling.

lines.zh: 两面脸同时微笑，却令人毛骨悚然。
lines.en: Both faces smile, chillingly.
Both faces stare at the void.
Stands quietly in the darkness.

lines.zh: 皮肤在微弱的光线下闪烁。
lines.en: Skin glows faintly in the light.
Whispers softly occasionally.
Each face in its own thoughts.
Alert, searching for a target.
Faces alternate looking around.

lines.zh: 保持不动，仿佛随时准备行动。
lines.en: Remains still, ready to act.
Wanders through the ruins of the End.

lines.zh: 偶尔变换姿态，保持新鲜感。
lines.en: Changes stance occasionally, staying fresh.

lines.zh: 它抬了抬与你同款的护甲
lines.en: It shifts a copy of your own armor.

lines.zh: 末地的紫色雾气绕着它
lines.en: The End's violet mist curls around it.

lines.zh: 它在等血量掉到下一段
lines.en: It waits for its health to drop to the next threshold.
Its shadow sits slightly out of step.

lines.zh: 它一遍遍默诵你的名字
lines.en: It repeats your name over and over.
It stands still, as if before a mirror.
Both faces turn to the player.
Dark eyes fix on the player.

lines.zh: 模仿玩家的动作，令人害怕。
lines.en: Mimics the player's actions, frighteningly.

lines.zh: 两面脸露出诡异的微笑。
lines.en: Both faces show a creepy smile.
Sssss softly at the player.

lines.zh: 警惕地盯着玩家的一举一动。
lines.en: Steadily watches the player's every move.
Both faces widen their eyes.
Echoes the player's tone in words.

lines.zh: 两面脸一起发出警告声。
lines.en: Both faces give a warning hiss.
Faces alternate looking at the player.

lines.zh: 它照你的样子抬起下巴
lines.en: It lifts its chin the way you do.

lines.zh: 它盯着你的剑，学着握紧
lines.en: It eyes your sword and tightens its grip the same way.
Doubled shadow stumbles on
Dark copy wavers
Two dark souls stagger
Shadow stumbles
Dark copy wobbles
Doubled shadow wavers
Dark doubles stagger
Two shadows stumble
Dark copy sways
It staggers half a step, then stands its ground again.

lines.zh: 它凝视你，眼中映出你的倒影。
lines.en: It stares at you, reflecting your image.

lines.zh: 戴上我的手套，体验我的力量。
lines.en: Wear my gloves and feel my power.

lines.zh: 你的装备，我照着复制一份。
lines.en: Your gear — I'll copy a set of my own.

lines.zh: 我的存在是为了复制你。
lines.en: I exist to replicate you.
My armor is indestructible.

lines.zh: 你的装备是我的，跟我来。
lines.en: Your gear is mine, follow me.
My armor is like yours.
The End, my home.
Remember every detail of you.
I will never truly fade.

lines.zh: 你的装备，我全套复制了。
lines.en: I've copied your whole loadout.

lines.zh: 我穿着复制的甲，和你一模一样。
lines.en: I wear copied armor, identical to yours.

lines.zh: 我们身体碰撞，你受伤了。
lines.en: Our bodies collide, and you get hurt.
My armor stops you.
Your strength cannot pierce me.
I absorb your attack.
You tried to breach my defenses.
My armor makes you powerless.

lines.zh: 你的攻击只能留下痕迹。
lines.en: Your attacks leave only scars.

lines.zh: 你的剑痕落在我护甲上，就没了。
lines.en: Your sword's mark fades off my armor the moment it lands.
You are my perfect replica.
Let's fight together.
You are my other half.
Copy your soul.
My existence is your mirror.
Your life is linked to mine.
Replicate everything about you.
I am your twin.
You and I, two souls.
My existence is for you.

lines.zh: 二重身浮现，黑暗中窥视着你。
lines.en: The doppelganger emerges, peering at you in the darkness.

lines.zh: 末地的回声，你的影子显现。
lines.en: An echo from the End, your shadow appears.

lines.zh: 装备已被复制，小心它的复刻力量。
lines.en: Your gear has been copied. Beware its duplicating power.

lines.zh: 黑暗中，你的影子静静地等待。
lines.en: In the darkness, your shadow waits quietly.

lines.zh: 黑暗中，它的注视令你不安。
lines.en: Its gaze in the darkness unsettles you.

lines.zh: 复制的装备，冰冷的威胁。
lines.en: Copied gear, a cold threat.

lines.zh: 它静静地站在黑暗中，无声无息。
lines.en: It stands silently in the darkness, soundless.
Your shadow is by your side.

lines.zh: 阴影中，它的双眼注视着你。
lines.en: In the shadows, its eyes watch you.

lines.zh: 影子在黑暗中缓缓移动。
lines.en: The shadow moves slowly in the darkness.

lines.zh: 黑暗中，你的一举一动尽在它的视野。
lines.en: In the darkness, every move of yours is within its sight.
Your shadow, its prey.
It waits, waiting for the right moment.
Your shadow, its target.
It approaches, silently in the shadows.

lines.zh: 它的目光，紧紧锁定着你。
lines.en: Its gaze locks on you.
It moves quietly in the darkness.

lines.zh: 它窥视着，寻找你的弱点。
lines.en: It窥视着,寻找你的弱点It scouts, seeking your weakness.
Your shadow in its eyes.
It approaches silently.
It declares: this round is a mirror.

lines.zh: 你的装备，它已穿戴整齐
lines.en: Your gear is already fitted to its body.

lines.zh: 它把你的名字穿在身上
lines.en: It wears your name like a coat.
The shadow moves first and it follows.
It recognizes the one who summoned you.

lines.zh: 它把你的招式算过一遍
lines.en: It has run through every move you know.
The End has another you now.
It watches you from inside the shadow orb.
It has chosen you as its opponent.
It raises the copied weapon.

lines.zh: 准备战斗，你的影子即将进攻。
lines.en: Prepare for battle, your shadow is about to attack.

lines.zh: 瞄准，瞄准，瞄准你的影子。
lines.en: Target, target, target your shadow.

lines.zh: 它的攻击，如同暗影一般。
lines.en: Its attack, like a shadow.
Its attack, silent.

lines.zh: 它的攻击，如同夜色般深沉。
lines.en: Its attack, as dark as the night.

lines.zh: 它的攻击，犹如影子般飘忽。
lines.en: Its attack, like a shadow, elusive.

lines.zh: 它的攻击，如同暗流般涌来。
lines.en: Its attack, like a hidden stream.

lines.zh: 它的攻击，如同梦境般虚幻。
lines.en: Its attack, like a dream.

lines.zh: 它的攻击，如同幽灵般无形。
lines.en: Its attack, like a ghost.

lines.zh: 它的攻击，如同暗影般难以捉摸。
lines.en: Its attack, like a shadow, hard to grasp.

lines.zh: 它抬手，法术与刀一起上
lines.en: It raises a hand, spell and blade together.

lines.zh: 它数你的护甲还剩几点
lines.en: It counts what is left of your armor.

lines.zh: 第二形态的影子拉长了
lines.en: The shadow of its second phase stretches long.

lines.zh: 它在你背后留了一只手
lines.en: It leaves a hand behind your back.
End stone cracks beneath its feet.
It waits for you to drain your last potion.

lines.zh: 它每次只让伤害渗进一点
lines.en: It lets the damage seep in a little at a time.
It circles you, drawing a ring.

lines.zh: 它在算六百点血那道线
lines.en: It is counting toward the six-hundred point line.
It sends its shadow a step ahead.
Sssss, closing in!
Two shadows, one strike!

lines.zh: 黑暗的复制品，致命打击！
lines.en: Dark copy, deadly blow!
Devour light, melee attack!
Transform, attack!
Consume your soul, attack!
Copy your power, attack!
Dark power, melee attack!
Devour light, you will fall!
Dark Doppelganger, deadly melee!
The giant shadow swings with your own move.
Its palm falls and your armor rings.

lines.zh: 复制品冲锋，撞得你后退
lines.en: The copy charges and knocks you back.
It pours shadow into the blow.
Shadow Pearl calls, appear!
End portal, dark entity!
Caller, here I am!
Copy of you, show myself!
Caller, your shadow!

lines.zh: 暗影宝珠的力量，我来了！
lines.en: Shadow Pearl's power, here I am!
Darkness in the End, I return!
King of the End, summon dark!
Copy of you, show yourself!

lines.zh: 召唤者，我是你的复制品！
lines.en: Caller, I am your copy!
The shadow orb cracks and it arrives.

lines.zh: 末地多出一道你的剪影
lines.en: A silhouette of you appears in the End.

lines.zh: 召唤者的装备被抄了一份
lines.en: The summoner's gear is copied once.
It has crawled back out of the void.

lines.zh: 紫色的雷在它身后炸开
lines.en: Violet lightning bursts behind it.
This time it is you who gets copied.
Black fire lights the End altar.
It takes shape wearing your face.
Health bar and music arrive together.
It registers itself as your opponent.
Fire burns me
Fall's pain

lines.zh: 末地的水不该存在，我却沉了。
lines.en: There shouldn't be water in the End, yet I'm sinking.
The blast tears my shadow apart.
Arrow hits me
Magic hits me
Starvation erodes me

lines.zh: 雷落在我复制的头盔上。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the helm I copied from you.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，我也会被拉回末地。
lines.en: Even the void sends me back to the End.
